statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered
The monitoring is to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion
The monitoring is to optimize rate control
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
